topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, the multistep model of tumor progression, and the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways and oncogenic mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations deregulate growth-promoting and growth-inhibitory cell signaling pathways.

topics.label: Blocks in terminal cellular differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells fail to terminally differentiate in hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the cellular mechanisms and genetic alterations governing apoptosis evasion and p53 regulation.

topics.label: Replicative immortalization, senescence, and growth-control summary
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover telomere dynamics, TERT reactivation, and p53-driven senescence, concluding the discussion on growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and metabolic reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring across tissue types, and the genetic mutations driving altered cancer metabolism.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascular regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the angiogenic switch, oxygen diffusion constraints, and the regulation of tumor vascularization.

topics.label: Mechanisms, inefficiency, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, factors governing secondary colonization, and the genomic features of metastases.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of cancer hallmarks, recommended reading, and closing remarks.
